decisions.reason: The client explicitly adds a concrete acceptance condition requiring the complete demonstration to show working speed adjustment.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
It’s good to hear that the machine is sturdy and its core functions are performing as expected. Thanks for the update.

Please repair the plumbing leak. Once it has been repaired, send me a complete demonstration video covering all of the following:

Both stations operating simultaneously.
Working speed adjustment.
Continuous operation for several minutes.
Water moving through both plumbing systems without any leaks.
Dispensing through both spouts.
The startup and shutdown sequence.

If everything operates correctly, please also provide a shipping date so that we can proceed to the project’s next phase.

value_updates.speed_adjustment_acceptance_condition: The complete demonstration must show working speed adjustment.

decisions.reason: Simultaneous station operation does not change the established bowl capacity, depth, geometry, or refilling policy.
The source does not change whisk length, depth, height, or positioning requirements.
The source requests operational demonstrations but does not change the required matcha texture, foam consistency, or smoothness.
The source does not alter the existing splash-control target or mitigation options.
The source contains no decision about whisk size, material, or head design.
The existing requirement already covers both mixing motors operating under simultaneous full-system load, so the source adds no new electrical-capacity state.
The functional demonstration request does not resume or modify the deferred decorative-lighting requirement.

A same-message Event already captures the complete continuous-operation acceptance condition, and the source does not necessarily require that condition to be combined with simultaneous dual-station operation.
The acknowledgement that the machine is sturdy does not change the structural-stability requirement, and implementation status must not be propagated as a MODIFY.
The operational checklist does not resume or modify the deferred DJ-style labels and visual-control styling.
The client explicitly requires the complete demonstration to show successful dispensing through both station spouts.
